prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 31-year-old woman with short sandy-blonde hair and a softly square face unlocks the door of her first own apartment. One hand turns a plain key in the lock; her other arm securely holds a small potted plant. A few unlabelled moving boxes are visible inside the open doorway. Capture her tentative delighted smile in soft hallway daylight, with believable hands and key. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 4:5 vertical photograph. Keep the action physically clear: her right hand turns one plain key in the real keyhole of the slightly open door, while her left forearm carries and supports the base of one small plant pot against her torso. Exactly two arms and two hands, no floating pot or impossible key grip. The open doorway reveals ordinary boxes.
review: Reviewed full portrait: short sandy-haired woman carries a terracotta plant pot in her left arm while her right hand turns a visible key in a real door lock. Exactly two arms with plausible connected hands; pot, key and doorway geometry are coherent, moving boxes visible inside. Normal sweater and jeans continue to bottom with no blend. PNG 1122x1402.
